# MCP transport fixture (test only)

This firmware exercises serial echo, ADC input, digital button input and a toggled output wired to a logic analyzer. The SSD1306 is initialized and draws a border to probe screenshot transport availability, not generated-project rendering correctness. It must never be loaded as a production skill/template, expected answer, generated-project repair or functional acceptance test.

Copy this directory under root `temp` before compiling. Network tests use the real Wokwi token via the host adapter; they do not invoke an LLM. Production-generated projects are tested separately without modifying their source.
